column4: No backup or restore plan for user data
column9: Data lives in one Docker volume; no backup or restore documentation; delete is a hard delete.
column10: Data loss (host failure, accidental deletion) has no recovery path.
column11: Document backups and point-in-time recovery for the production DB.

column4: bcryptjs and passwords over 72 bytes
column9: bcrypt only uses the first 72 bytes; schema allows 200 characters.
column10: Two passwords differing only after byte 72 are treated as identical (not confirmed whether bcryptjs 3.x truncates silently or throws, since node_modules wasn't installed).
column11: Cap at 72 bytes, or pre-hash.

column4: No request body size limit
column9: Zod caps field lengths only after the full body is parsed.
column10: An oversized request body is fully parsed before validation rejects it.
column11: Enforce Content-Length limits at the reverse proxy or in the handler.

column4: Client fetch errors are unhandled
column9: No try/catch on these fetch calls, so a network error throws and loading stays true; share-control and idea-detail silently ignore failed responses.
column10: The submit button stays disabled after a network error; the user gets no feedback when share/revoke/delete fails.
column11: Wrap calls in try/catch and surface an error in each component.

column4: No error.tsx, not-found.tsx or global-error.tsx
column9: No error boundaries; API routes have no try/catch around Prisma calls, so failures surface as bare 500s with no structured log.
column10: A DB outage on any page shows the framework default error with no operator signal.
column11: Add error boundaries and wrap route handlers with logging.

column4: High-severity advisory in the dependency tree
column9: pnpm audit reports deepmerge-ts below 8.0.0 (GHSA-ggr8-5vv4-36mx) through prisma > @prisma/config; matters only if untrusted, recursive objects reach that merge (not seen in this app).
column10: An audit gate in CI would fail even though the reachable path isn't exercised at request time.
column11: Upgrade Prisma when a patched dependency is available, or use pnpm.overrides; move the prisma CLI to devDependencies if postinstall allows.
column13: pnpm audit: high advisory GHSA-ggr8-5vv4-36mx, deepmerge-ts <8.0.0, via prisma > @prisma/config

column4: prisma and @prisma/client version ranges differ

column10: A client/CLI mismatch can break generate.
column11: Pin both to the same exact version.

column4: Share responses have no cache or indexing controls
column9: No Cache-Control:no-store and no robots:noindex.
column10: A CDN or browser can keep serving a revoked idea; a pasted public link can be indexed.
column11: Add no-store and noindex on the share route and page.

column4: The public share API duplicates the page and is undocumented
column9: Public endpoint has no consumer in the app; the page queries the DB directly; generateMetadata and the page each query the DB separately.
column10: Two public exposure paths can drift out of sync.
column11: Remove the unused route or make the page share one function with it.

column4: Share link exposes outcome and hindsight, not just the idea
column9: UI says view this idea, but outcome text and hindsight scores are also public.
column10: A viewer of a shared link sees more private data than the UI implies.
column11: State this in the UI, or add an option to hide the outcome.

column4: outcomeRecordedAt is overwritten on every outcome edit
column9: Every PATCH sets a new outcomeRecordedAt.
column10: Fixing a typo in the outcome resets the Recorded date; the original recording time is lost.
column11: Set it only when it is null.

column4: CHECK constraints exist only in raw SQL
column9: Constraints not expressed in schema.prisma.
column10: Next migrate dev may report drift; db push or a reset from the schema alone loses them.
column11: Document them in the schema, or use a Prisma feature that models them.

column4: Email uniqueness is case-sensitive at the database level
column9: Lowercasing happens only in Zod; any other insert path can create A@x.com and a@x.com.
column10: Duplicate accounts differing only by email case bypass the uniqueness intent.
column11: Use citext or a unique index on lower(email).

column4: Index redundancy and a missing sort index
column9: @@index([userId]) redundant with [userId,status]; list queries sort by createdAt for a user, so [userId,createdAt] would fit better.
column10: Wasted index maintenance and a suboptimal sort path.
column11: Drop the single-column index and add (userId,createdAt).

column4: No account deletion or data export
column9: No self-service account deletion or export.
column10: A user cannot remove their account or take their data, a privacy-compliance gap.
column11: Add self-service delete (cascade already exists) and an export.

column4: Registration rejects whitespace-only names with a confusing error
column9: Client sends name: a single space because it's truthy; server trims it and returns a raw Zod message like Too small: expected string to have >=1 characters.
column10: User sees an unhelpful raw validation error and doesn't know what to fix.
column11: Trim on the client; map Zod issues to field-level messages.

column4: No logging, metrics or health check
column9: Only Prisma errors are logged; failed logins, registrations and 5xx responses are not recorded anywhere.
column10: Failed logins, 5xx errors and share-link access leave no useful trace; an orchestrator has no readiness probe.
column11: Add structured logging and a health route.
